text: 据新华社，7月11日上午，中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李强在北京人民大会堂同来华进行正式访问的朝鲜劳动党中央政治局常委、国务委员会副委员长、内阁总理朴泰成举行会谈。
text_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, on the morning of July 11, Premier Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, held talks at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing with Pak Thae-song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Vice Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, and Premier of the Cabinet, who was on an official visit to China.
